text: It hides its burrow by making a plug out of dung. This deters would-be predators by both sight and scent.

text: Every 17 years it emerges with all of its species to eat, reproduce, and die.
Once it reaches a certain age its horns never stop growing, so it has to constantly wear them down by fighting or grinding them on rocks.

text: For every year of life, it grows a new shell over its existing one. When it dies, its remains resemble nesting dolls.

text: Its bite is not venomous, but its saliva teems with harmful microbes that give any animal that survives the bite a severe infection.
